messages:
nina-sales: FYI GreenLattice submitted an RFP follow-up asking for an explicit POC pricing table, a sample runbook for an on-prem validation, and our capability matrix with BYOK/HSM details. I uploaded their form here: https://files.redwood/gl/rfp-form.pdf. Can we consolidate answers by EOD tomorrow?

owen-se: Reviewing now. Key constraints: they want a 5-day POC (very tight) and require automated reproducibility for our evals. We usually do 7 days but can compress to 5 if we scope the baseline tests only. Need to call out what we won't cover in compressed window.

lina-solutions: For pricing, propose: per-GPU/day (p4d-equivalent) as a base, eng support rate per-day, and optional HSM integration engineering as a fixed one-time fee. I'll draft a line-item spreadsheet. Also suggest including an "overage" daily rate if POC extends.

rahul-sre: Ops notes: For Private (on-prem) installs we provide an install checklist and runbook. SLA for Private is conditional: we can offer a 99.9% SLA only if we operate the control plane and networking; otherwise we provide an "assistance" SLA (response targets). For Dedicated we can offer 99.95% with standard credit schedule.

zoe-legal: On liability: avoid open percentage liquidated damages. Recommend service credits capped at a fixed % of monthly charges. For POC contracts keep liability limited and include a mutual confidentiality paragraph for the sanitized eval set. I can attach a redline.

nina-sales: Uploaded their RFP and our current capability matrix (v3): capability_matrix_greenlattice_v3.xlsx :paperclip:

upload-bot: File uploaded: capability_matrix_greenlattice_v3.xlsx (by nina-sales)

owen-se: Couple of technical asks the buyer listed: 1) BYOK support with AES-256 keys + HSM option, 2) quantization tradeoffs and sample latency numbers, 3) fallback routing when capacity constrained. We should add a small table: model variant vs expected latencies (fp16, int8, q4) at 512 tokens.

lina-solutions: I'll add quantization notes and a small latency matrix. Also include Optimize presets (auto-batching, kv-cache) under "cost controls".

rahul-sre: For the runbook, include commands and a minimal config snippet. Example:

```
# minimal private install snippet
redwood_controlplane:
  mode: managed
  region: us-west-2
nodes:
  - type: p4d
    count: 2
batching:
  default_max_batch: 64
```

rahul-sre: Also recommend we include recommended autoscale policy for the POC: min 1 node, target CPU 70% for scaling up, cooldown 60s.

nina-sales: Customer also asked for a sample acceptance criteria checklist for the POC (latency p95 < X ms, throughput Y req/s, quality delta < Z). Can we standardize one?

owen-se: Draft acceptance criteria: p95 latency < 250ms for targeted model at 512 tokens (Dedicated config), throughput >= 50 req/s sustained for 5 minutes, and generation quality measured by BLEU/ROUGE decrease <= 5% against baseline prompts. Note we should adapt metrics to their use-case (retrieval-augmented vs pure generation).

lina-solutions: I'll assemble the POC schedule compressed to 5 days with explicit scope gating:

```
Compressed POC (5 days) - scope: baseline perf + basic integration
Day 0: Kickoff, access, scope confirmation, data transfer guidelines
Day 1: Provisioning + observability (token cost dashboard, per-route traces)
Day 2: Baseline latency/throughput runs (fp16 + int8)
Day 3: Run sanitized eval + quality checks
Day 4: Tuning knobs (batch sizes, kv-cache) + final acceptance run
Day 5: Wrap, handoff, artifacts + optional extension plan
```

zoe-legal: Uploading redlined SLA & NDA snippets. Will not include FedRAMP claims. We can share SOC2 summary and compliance roster.

upload-bot: File uploaded: redline_sla_greenlattice.docx (by zoe-legal)

nina-sales: Next steps: Lina to update capability matrix with HSM/BYOK + quantization latency table, Owen to assemble sanitized eval set and sample notebook, Rahul to add runbook snippets and autoscale matrix, Zoe to finalize legal redlines. I'll draft the RFP response PDF and attach the matrix + runbook. Targeting to send to customer first thing AM. :rocket:

owen-se: I'll also prepare a short reproducibility README and a script to run the eval so the buyer can reproduce results locally.

lina-solutions: Note: we'll add a fallback paragraph: if Dedicated capacity is unavailable we can route to a compatible quantized variant or an alternate region. Keep wording high-level; legal will review.

nina-sales: Thanks all. Ping me when uploads are ready and I'll assemble.

upload-bot: Message pinned by nina-sales: 1776543210 (GreenLattice RFP thread).
